out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Observed no Employee Health Policy in place
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED HARD COPIES OF THE FAIRFAX COUNTY EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY FOR STAFF TO READ AND SIGN. STAFF READ AND SIGN A COPY DURING THE INSPECTION. RETAIN FOR FUTURE INSPECTIONS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed a large pitcher being stored in the basins of the two hand sinks in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC. MOVED THE PITCHERS OUT OF THE HAND SINK. HAND SINKS ARE FOR HAND WASHING ONLY.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw ground meat and Raw lamb was being stored above cooked onions and cooked lamb in the walk in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE COOKED FOODS TO THE TOP SHLEF AWAY FROM THE RAW FOODS. EHS PROVIDED PIC A PREVENTING CROSS CONTAMINATION DIAGRAM

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) unsalted butter in counter top warmer was observed at 107f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED THE BUTTER. HOT FOODS MUST BE KEPT AT 135f OR HIGHER.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR glass countertop cooler: mango lassi was observed at 45-46f. Upon discussion with PIC, mango lassi was prepared less than 2 hours prior to inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED THE MANGO LASSI INTO THE WALK-IN COOLER TO COOL TO 41f.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1) 1DR glass countertop cooler 2) 2DR prep top cooler
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLACE A WORKING AMBIENT AIR THERMOMETER IN THE TWO COOLERS BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Observed employee wash his gloved hands and resume working.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO NOT WASH GLOVED HANDS. WHEN CHANGING TASKS, TAKE OFF GLOVES AND WASH HANDS PROPERLY BEFORE PUTTING ON NEW GLOVES.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food being stored on the floor in the walk-in and in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE FOOD OFF THE FLOOR TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed small cups and bowls being stored inside the bulk spices bins.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EMPLOYEE REMOVED THE SMALL CUPS. SCOOPS WITH HANDLES CAN BE STORED ON THE OUTSIDE OF THE CONTAINER OR INSIDE WITH THE HANDLE STICKING UPWARDS.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: EHS observed containers of flour, salt, sugar rice, and spices without labels
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC agreed to make labels for containers of unlabeled ingredients

violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: EHS observed non- NSF approved containers being used to store spices and dry goods.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PIC agreed to acquire NSF approved restaurant containers for spices by next inspection.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. EHS observed wiping cloths soaked in sanitizer solution being stored on counters and food contact surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC moved wiping cloths to be stored in sanitizer solution.

violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. EHS observed employees purses and coats being stored where it can contaminate food contact surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. PIC moved employee personal items to storage area
